description: A test suite for browser file upload, download, and navigation functionalities using Playwright, including scenarios for file access restrictions and upload configurations.

methods.name: browser_file_upload
methods.description: Test for uploading files via browser automation, including error handling and modal state management.

methods.name: clicking on download link emits download
methods.description: Test for clicking a download link and verifying the download event.

methods.name: navigating to download link emits download
methods.description: Test for navigation to a download link and verifying the download is handled correctly.

methods.name: file upload restricted to roots by default
methods.description: Test to ensure file uploads are only permitted within specified root directories.

methods.name: file upload is restricted to cwd if no roots are configured
methods.description: Test to verify default restriction to current working directory for file uploads.

methods.name: file upload unrestricted when flag is set
methods.description: Test that file uploads are unrestricted when the appropriate configuration flag is enabled.
